name: semiotic
description: React data visualization library for charts, networks, and beyond

function.name: LineChart
function.description: Line traces with curve interpolation, area fill, and point markers. Use for time series, trends, and continuous data.

mode.description: Display mode controlling default size, decoration, margins, labels, and interaction.

margin.description: Uniform numeric margin or an object margin. Numeric sides are minima when chart-owned chrome such as legends needs more room; "auto", null, and omitted sides start from chart-mode defaults.

title.description: Visible chart title and the chart's accessible name.

description.description: Concise accessible description that overrides the chart's generated aria-label.

summary.description: Screen-reader-only summary of the chart's key takeaway; include keyboard interaction guidance when relevant.

accessibleTable.description: Expose the chart data through Semiotic's screen-reader data table. Object form `{ portalTarget: string }` relocates its interactive UI to the DOM element with that ID.

portalTarget.description: ID of a DOM element outside any consumer-owned role=img wrapper. React callers may also pass an Element or a callback through the typed API.

legendInteraction.description: Legend interaction mode: highlight on hover, isolate on click, or none.

legendPosition.description: Position the legend beside or above/below the plot.

tooltip.description: Tooltip: true/false, "multi", { mode: "multi", content? }, a custom function, or { fields, title } config. Multi mode shows every series at the hovered x; custom multi content receives allSeries/xValue.

annotations.description: Annotation objects to render on the chart. Each must have a `type` field. Position using your data field names (e.g. { type: "widget", month: "Jan", revenue: 500 }). Supported types: "widget" (arbitrary HTML/React content via foreignObject — v3 replacement for htmlAnnotationRules), "label" (callout with connector), "callout" (circle + label), "text" (plain data-anchored label), "frame-text" (serializable plot-relative text for endpoints and chart-adjacent chrome), "y-threshold" (horizontal reference line), "x-threshold" (vertical reference line), "band" (shaded y-region), "x-band" (shaded x-region), "enclose" (circle around points), "rect-enclose" (rect around points), "highlight" (colored dots on filtered points), "trend" (regression line), "envelope" (upper/lower bounds), "anomaly-band" (mean ± stddev), "forecast" (extrapolated trend). Frame-text annotations accept: label or text, position ("top-left"|"top-center"|"top-right"|"middle-left"|"center"|"middle-right"|"bottom-left"|"bottom-center"|"bottom-right"), dx, dy, fill/color, fontSize, fontWeight. Widget annotations accept: content (ReactNode), dx, dy, width, height, anchor ("fixed"|"latest"|"sticky"). Threshold annotations accept: value, label, color, strokeWidth, strokeDasharray. Band annotations accept `y0`/`y1`; x-band annotations accept `x0`/`x1`; either bound may be omitted to extend to the axis extent. Either band may use `color` as its solid-fill alias or `gradient: { stops: [{ offset: 0-1, color, opacity? }], direction?: "horizontal"|"vertical" }`; y-bands default vertical and x-bands horizontal. Enclose annotations accept: coordinates (array of data objects), label, color, padding.

autoPlaceAnnotations.description: Opt-in annotation placement pass. Chooses dx/dy for note-like annotations without manual offsets and avoids note/mark/edge overlaps where possible.

responsiveRules.description: Semantic responsive transforms applied before chart-mode defaults.

mobileSemantics.description: Phone/mobile contract consumed by audits, recipes, adapters, and agents.

mobileInteraction.description: Touch-first interaction policy for phone-sized chart slots.

maxDevicePixelRatio.description: Maximum canvas backing-store DPR. Defaults to 3 on desktop and 2 on coarse-pointer/small-screen devices; large canvases are further capped to an 8-megapixel, 16K-side backing-store budget; canvases repaint when browser zoom or display density changes.

axisExtent.description: Tick endpoint mode. "nice" rounds endpoints to readable values; "exact" pins the first and last tick to the actual data min and max with equidistant intermediates. Affects XY x/y axes and ordinal value axis only.

animate.description: Enable mark transitions (boolean or {duration?, easing?, intro?}).

hoverHighlight.description: Dim non-hovered series/categories (true or the series-level mode; requires colorBy).

chartId.description: Stable id for linked selection / observation / nav sync.

xScaleType.description: x scale type. "time" builds a scaleTime (required for landmark ticks on timestamps).

yScaleType.description: y scale type. "symlog" supports signed values while compressing large magnitudes.

styleRules.description: Ordered declarative style rules; matching styles merge in order and the last value wins per property. Wire configs accept boolean/declarative-threshold `when` values and object styles (including cursor and solid or HatchFill fill). Predicate and style functions are React-only.

data.description: Array of data objects

xAccessor.description: Key or accessor function for x-axis values. Functions can derive a value, e.g. `d => d.timestamp`.

yAccessor.description: Key or accessor function for y-axis values. Functions support dynamic lookups, e.g. `d => d[d.metricLabel]`.

lineBy.description: Key to group data into separate lines

lineDataAccessor.description: Key for the coordinates array within each line object

showPoints.description: Show data point markers on the line

pointRadius.description: Radius of point markers when showPoints is true

pointIdAccessor.description: Stable ID for point annotations and push-mode remove()/update().

fillArea.description: Fill every line or configure selected filled series.

lineGradient.description: Left-to-right stroke gradient: { stops: [{ offset: 0-1, color?, opacity? }] }.

directLabel.description: Place series labels at their start or end points instead of relying only on a legend.

gapStrategy.description: How missing y values are rendered: break the line, interpolate across them, or drop to zero.

forecast.description: Forecast overlay config — tagged training/observed/forecast region with optional envelope. See ForecastConfig.

anomaly.description: Anomaly overlay config — ±σ band + anomaly dot annotations. See AnomalyConfig.

band.description: Asymmetric min/max envelope drawn under the line. `{ y0Accessor, y1Accessor, style?, perSeries?, interactive? }` or an array of those for percentile fans. Distinct from `forecast`/`anomaly` (computed) — band is pure data passthrough. Hovered datum is enriched with `band: { y0, y1 }` and `bands: [...]`.

xExtent.description: Fixed x domain `[min, max]`; either bound may be omitted.

yExtent.description: Fixed y domain `[min, max]`; either bound may be omitted.

brush.description: Enable an x-axis brush overlay for range selection.

linkedBrush.description: LinkedCharts brush channel name, or { name, xField?, yField? }.
